user.changePassLead: Use the new password next time you sign in.
user.createJobLead: Choose image or video, then describe what you want. Only fields for that mode are shown.
user.mediaPrompt: Describe what you want to generate
user.mediaPromptPh: e.g. a river at dusk with lights in the distance.
user.mediaPickNone: No completed jobs to choose from yet
user.mediaNoUpload: There is no media upload API. Pick a completed job, or paste a reachable URL.
user.mediaFailedHint: The job failed. See the reason above; you can edit the prompt and retry.
user.mediaPollInterrupted: Status updates stopped. Refresh to continue.
user.walletBucketsDetail: API usage consumes gift credits before purchased credits. Gift credits are non-refundable. Commission is settled separately and cannot pay for API usage.

reconcile.lead: Reconcile the three buckets with the same-window usage. Matches stay green. Mismatches only go to the pending queue — never estimate-debit.
reconcile.flagged: Sent to the pending reconciliation queue
reconcile.emptyDetail: Empty stays empty. No fake charts or trends.
reconcile.pendingLead: Gaps already in the queue. Replay real tokens on the usage page. No estimate-debit here.

channelUi.needAdmin: Not signed in as channel admin
channelUi.usersLead: Attribution is locked at signup. This list is this channel's scope only — no other channels or platform cost.
channelUi.usersHint: Channel admins only see users in this channel. Emails may be masked.
channelUi.emptyUsersDetail: No users have signed up with this channel’s promo code yet. Create a code on the promo page first.
channelUi.plansLead: Low price or high-risk quota goes to platform review. This channel’s plans only.
channelUi.plansHint: Channel admins see this channel's plans and platform plans, not other channels' catalogs.
channelUi.createHint: Prices below $1 or high-risk quota go to pending review. The plan belongs to this channel and cannot become an official plan.
channelUi.planPricePh: USD amount; under $1 goes to review
channelUi.emptyPlansDetail: No channel plans yet. Create one with the form below. Low-price or high-risk quotas go to platform review.
channelUi.promosLead: Send the code, or copy a login link with the promo parameter.
channelUi.promosHint: Promo links belong to this channel. Signup locks attribution on the server.
channelUi.confirmPromoD: This code belongs to this channel. Signup locks attribution on the server.
channelUi.emptyPromosDetail: Create one and send the login link with the promo parameter. Attribution is locked at signup.
channelUi.attrLead: Counted by promo code and partner tier. Channels cannot reassign someone else.
channelUi.attrHint: Attribution is locked at signup. This channel's codes only.
channelUi.emptyAttrDetail: Attribution is locked at signup. This channel's codes only.
channelUi.usageLead: Tokens and media seconds come from settled usage, not estimates.
channelUi.usageHint: Channel usage sums confirmed usage in this channel only. No other channels or prompts.
channelUi.settleLead: Monthly settlements after commission freeze. No other channels, no prompts.
channelUi.settleHint: Channels only see their own settlements. P0 payout is manual platform finance.
channelUi.emptySettleDetail: Monthly docs after freeze. P0 payout is manual platform finance.
channelUi.commHint: Channel admins see commission and quota for this channel. No prompts.
channelUi.commLead: Available quota {quota}. User top-ups issue service credit at the platform ratio (read-only, default 1:1). Chat does not debit the channel again. Commission is on the platform.
channelUi.emptyIssuedDetail: Quota issued when downline users top up will show up here.
channelUi.keysLead: Keys for users in this channel. No secrets, no create, no limit edits.
channelUi.keysHint: Channel admins can disable keys in this channel; the gateway returns 403 right away.
channelUi.emptyKeys: No API keys in this channel
channelUi.emptyKeysDetail: This channel has no API keys yet. Keys created under this channel will show up here.
channelUi.confirmDisableKeyD: The gateway will return 403 immediately. Do not disable the main e2e key.
channelUi.ledgerHint: Offline payments are bookkeeping only. Enter a positive USD amount; it is stored negative.
channelUi.pnlLead: Available {quota}. PnL = consumed + marketing + supplier. Unconsumed is not profit.
channelUi.supplierLead: C and B under A book pay-to-platform. B under C books pay-to-that-C. Do not send a channel id.
channelUi.confirmSupplierD: Offline payment, online bookkeeping. Stored as a negative amount.
channelUi.emptySupplierDetail: Refresh to see this channel's offline payments.
channelUi.confirmReverseD: Adds a paired reversing row. Original stays.
channelUi.wholesaleLead: Moves available credits from this C into that B's own pool.
channelUi.wholesaleNeed: Pick a child B and a positive amount
channelUi.confirmWholesaleD: Deducts this C's available balance and credits the B pool.
channelUi.createBLead: C can only create B, never another C. The new B gets its own credit pool.
channelUi.confirmCreateBD: Copies the platform model whitelist. Tenants cannot add providers.
channelUi.rulesHint: C can edit this market. B is read-only.
channelUi.rulesWriteHint: Changes apply to later usage and eligibility, not posted rows.
channelUi.rulesReadHint: This channel cannot edit rates. Showing the platform or parent C policy.
channelUi.policyLead: BPS is parts per 10,000. Direct + indirect cannot exceed the total.
channelUi.eligLead: Spend / top-up thresholds grant commission eligibility. Ineligible shares grant gift credits.
channelUi.eligInherited: Showing inherited rules (platform or parent C). This channel cannot edit them.
channelUi.confirmEligD: Applies to later eligibility and signup gifts.

referral.title: My referrals
referral.shareDetail: This link fills in your referral code automatically. Invitations apply to newly registered accounts only.
referral.copyFailed: Copy failed. Select the link above and copy it manually.
referral.createFailed: Could not create the link. Please retry.
referral.retryDetail: Refresh to retry. Contact your channel administrator if the issue persists.
referral.commissionDetail: Confirmed API usage by referred users earns direct or indirect commission under your channel rules, up to two levels. Top-ups do not earn commission. After the freeze period, commission enters your separate commission wallet and cannot pay for API usage. Finance handles settlement and payout.
referral.giftDetail: New users registering through your link currently receive {amount} in non-refundable API credits. These credits go to the invited user; you do not currently earn cash commission. Eligibility and channel rules at registration apply.
referral.giftDisabled: Referral signup credits are currently disabled, and you are not yet eligible for cash commission.
referral.qualify: Meet either condition to automatically qualify for commission:
referral.qualificationDisabled: Automatic qualification is currently disabled. Contact your channel administrator for details.
referral.rewardsDetail: Your latest 200 commission records, excluding earnings of other promoters. Invited users can view their signup credits in their own wallets.
referral.emptyRewardsDetail: Records appear after you qualify and referred users incur eligible API usage.
referral.reversalHelp: Match original and reversal entries by consumption request. Reversed entries no longer count toward payable earnings; signed amounts remain for reconciliation.

entitlements.title: My credits and expiry
entitlements.help: Bonus and plan credits are used before wallet credit for API usage. Expired credits cannot be used.
entitlements.loadError: Could not load credits. Select Refresh credits to retry.
entitlements.empty: No bonus or plan credits yet.
entitlements.plansLoadError: Could not load plans. Refresh plans to retry.
entitlements.walletHelp: Time-limited bonus and plan credits are separate from the balances above.
